2607.29378.title: PTP: Previous-Token Prediction based LLM Inversion for Near-Exact Prompt Reconstruction
2607.29378.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) generate text by auto-regressively sampling the next token. This inherently leads to a many-to-many mapping between prompts and responses, complicating the task of inferring prompts from observed outputs. Prior work on LLM inversion frames prompt recovery as a semantic reconstruction task. They rely on fine-tuning pretrained sequence-to-sequence models on large external datasets--and requiring access to model weights or logits--to generate semantically plausible prompts. In contrast, we present a functional approach to inverting a given LLM in a black-box setting, without auxiliary aids. We train an explicit inverse language model entirely from scratch on data synthetically generated from the target LLM itself. Analogous to forward next-token prediction, our inverse model is trained using previous-token prediction, establishing a generative link between the forward and inverse processes that enables faithful prompt reconstruction. Moreover, it naturally supports diverse prompt reconstructions through sampling, whereby all such prompts induce similar responses under the forward, target LLM. Our approach generalises across datasets and exhibits transferability in reconstructing prompts from responses generated by different LLMs. Further, across the set of token based evaluation metrics for prompt and response reconstructions, our approach outperforms prior work.
2607.29378.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）通過自回歸地抽樣下一個標記來生成文本。這本質上導致了提示與回應之間的多對多映射，從而使從觀察到的輸出中推斷提示的任務變得複雜。先前關於LLM反演的研究將提示恢復框架為一個語義重建任務。它們依賴於在大型外部數據集上微調預訓練的序列到序列模型——並需要訪問模型權重或logits——以生成語義上合理的提示。相比之下，我們提出了一種在黑箱環境中反演給定LLM的功能性方法，而不需要輔助工具。我們完全從頭開始訓練了一個明確的逆語言模型，數據是從目標LLM本身合成生成的。類似於前向下一標記預測，我們的逆模型使用前一標記預測進行訓練，建立了前向和逆向過程之間的生成聯繫，使得提示重建得以忠實實現。此外，它通過抽樣自然支持多樣的提示重建，所有這些提示在前向目標LLM下都會引發類似的回應。我們的方法在數據集之間具有普遍性，並在從不同LLM生成的回應中重建提示時表現出可轉移性。此外，在針對提示和回應重建的基於標記的評估指標集上，我們的方法超越了先前的工作。
